blocks.orig: Wander up Kilimanjaro via the 8-day Northern Circuit Route
blocks.html: Hike up Kilimanjaro on the 8-day Northern Circuit Route

blocks.orig: The Northern Circuit route is the newest route to climb Kilimanjaro. The route is unique as you hike via the quiet, still rather unknown northern side of the mountain. You will see Mount Kilimanjaro from a whole new perspective!
blocks.html: Of all the ways up Kilimanjaro, the Northern Circuit is the newest route. What sets it apart is that you walk along the quiet and still fairly unknown northern flank of the mountain, so you get to see Mount Kilimanjaro from an entirely fresh angle!

blocks.orig: The hikes per day on the Northern Circuit route are relatively short. This gives your body enough time to recover. In addition, the Northern Circuit route is good for acclimatization, as it is a relatively long climb (in days). Your body has more time to get used to the daily increase in altitude.
blocks.html: Each day's walking on the Northern Circuit route is fairly short, which gives your body plenty of time to recover. Because the climb also spans a relatively large number of days, the Northern Circuit route is good for acclimatisation: your body has extra time to adapt to the altitude you gain every day.

blocks.orig: The entire ascent (including descent) via the Northern Circuit Route takes 8 days.
blocks.html: Via the Northern Circuit Route, the full climb (descent included) takes 8 days.

blocks.orig: Your Tanzania Trip offers a unique service throughout the climb
blocks.html: Throughout the climb, Your Tanzania Trip provides a unique service

blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate challenge! Little details can make a world of difference, which is why with us, you climb with professional guides, porters, and a cook. They take care of you during your ascent via the Northern Circuit route, by checking your health twice a day and serving you delicious food. Sounds like a bit much? Not if you want to reach the top! Because we know that altitude sickness can creep up on you unnoticed and that proper nutrition* is essential to keep you going during a strenuous climb.
blocks.html: Taking on Kilimanjaro is the ultimate challenge! Small details can make a huge difference, so with us you climb with professional guides, porters and a cook. During your ascent along the Northern Circuit route they look after you, checking your health twice a day and serving you tasty meals. Does that sound like a lot? Not if reaching the summit is your goal! We know that altitude sickness can sneak up on you without warning, and that good nutrition* is vital to keep you going on such a demanding climb.

blocks.orig: *If you would like to see the menu, we can send it in advance.
blocks.html: *Would you like to see the menu? We can send it to you beforehand.

blocks.orig: If you like advice on how to prepare yourself for climbing Kilimanjaro, you can always contact us or read our blog How to prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?
blocks.html: Would you like tips on getting ready to climb Kilimanjaro? Feel free to get in touch with us, or read our blog How do you prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you on arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel, where you can rest after your flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb begins you meet your guide, who gives you a briefing and advises you on clothing, packing and other useful tips so that your climb is as comfortable as possible.

blocks.orig: Your adventure starts at your hotel, where your driver picks you up and drives you to Londorossi Gate (on the west side). You then go to Lemosho trailhead for lunch and begin the climb. This easy walk through dense rainforest lasts 3 to 4 hours and offers the chance to spot various animals, including buffalo and monkeys. After a narrow path and a few steep sections, you reach Big Tree Camp, where you spend the night.
blocks.html: The adventure begins at your hotel, where your driver collects you and takes you to Londorossi Gate (on the west side). From there you continue to the Lemosho trailhead for lunch and start climbing. This gentle walk through thick rainforest takes 3 to 4 hours, and you may see various animals along the way, such as buffalo and monkeys. Following a narrow path and a few steep stretches, you arrive at Big Tree Camp for the night.

blocks.orig: This morning you leave the forest to enter an environment of meadow heather and volcanic rock. You ascend and descend through the lush hills below the Shira Plateau, the third of Kilimanjaro’s volcanic peaks. Upon reaching the edge of the plateau, the long 5-6 hour hike ends, and the trail becomes easier. You then arrive at Shira Camp, where you spend the night enjoying an incredible view of the Kibo summit.
blocks.html: This morning the forest gives way to a landscape of meadow heather and volcanic rock. You climb up and down through the green hills beneath the Shira Plateau, the third of Kilimanjaro’s volcanic peaks. Once you reach the rim of the plateau, the long 5-6 hour walk is behind you and the path gets easier. You then reach Shira Camp, where you stay overnight with a magnificent view of the Kibo summit.

blocks.orig: Today’s hike lasts 7-8 hours and takes you from Heather into the alpine desert. You pass the Shira Plateau, one of the highest in the world, on the way to the Lava Tower, with an optional visit to the Shira Cathedral. From the Lava Tower, the path continues northwest toward Kibo, the highest peak of Kilimanjaro. Afterwards, you follow a steep trail to Moir Hut Camp, a remote spot with stunning views over the Shira Plateau.
blocks.html: Today you walk for 7-8 hours, leaving the Heather zone for the alpine desert. On your way to the Lava Tower you cross the Shira Plateau, one of the highest in the world, and you can choose to visit the Shira Cathedral. Beyond the Lava Tower the trail heads northwest towards Kibo, Kilimanjaro's highest peak. A steep path then brings you to Moir Hut Camp, a remote place with superb views across the Shira Plateau.

blocks.orig: As you continue the route on the Northern Circuit, you get over a steep ridge along the main path. Today's hike lasts about 8 to 9 hours, taking you through heathland and alpine desert to Buffalo Camp. In the morning, you have the option to make a quick detour to Little Lent Hill.
blocks.html: Carrying on along the Northern Circuit, you cross a steep ridge on the main trail. The walk today takes roughly 8 to 9 hours and leads through heathland and alpine desert to Buffalo Camp. In the morning you can choose to take a short detour to Little Lent Hill.

blocks.orig: On the fifth day on the mountain, you continue across diverse landscapes, including heathland, valleys, and alpine environments. The Northern Circuit route heads eastward and is less frequented, allowing for a peaceful experience of the scenery, wilderness, and stunning mountains. This trek takes approximately 5 to 7 hours.
blocks.html: On your fifth day on the mountain you keep crossing varied terrain, from heathland to valleys and alpine zones. Heading east, the Northern Circuit route sees fewer climbers, so you can enjoy the scenery, the wilderness and the beautiful mountains in peace. This stretch takes about 5 to 7 hours.

blocks.orig: Today involves a 4-5 hour climb to reach the "Saddle", a stunning lunar landscape between Mawenzi and Kibo Peaks. From there, you continue to School Hut Camp, arriving in the early afternoon. You have the rest of the day to relax and prepare for the final ascent the following day.
blocks.html: Today you climb for 4-5 hours up to the "Saddle", a striking moon-like landscape between Mawenzi and Kibo Peaks. You then carry on to School Hut Camp, which you reach in the early afternoon. The remainder of the day is yours to rest and get ready for the final ascent the next day.

blocks.orig: Around midnight, the summit push begins in the cold. Prepare for the steep path to Gilman’s Point, the rim of the main crater. After ascending for a few hours with short breaks, you reach Gilman’s Point to witness a breathtaking sunrise over Mawenzi Peak. Continue for 2-3 hours to Uhuru Peak, where you celebrate your success with incredible views. You then descend to Millenium Camp via Kibo Huts Camp, where you have dinner and spend your last night on the mountain.
blocks.html: The summit attempt starts in the cold at around midnight. Get ready for the steep trail to Gilman’s Point, on the rim of the main crater. After a few hours of climbing with short rests you arrive at Gilman’s Point in time for a breathtaking sunrise over Mawenzi Peak. Another 2-3 hours bring you to Uhuru Peak, where you celebrate your achievement with spectacular views. Then you descend via Kibo Huts Camp to Millenium Camp, where dinner and your final night on the mountain await.

blocks.orig: Finally, you appreciate the drop in altitude. After breakfast, you walk to the national park's exit. Following the descent, the group gathers to congratulate each other. Your driver takes you back to the hotel, where you enjoy a shower, a delicious dinner, and a well-deserved rest.
blocks.html: At last you can enjoy the lower altitude. After breakfast you hike to the exit of the national park. Once down, the group comes together to congratulate one another. Your driver brings you back to the hotel, where a shower, a tasty dinner and a well-earned rest are waiting.

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has come to an end and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Not ready for it to end? You can also extend your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few days of safari or a beach holiday!
